title: OpenAI is coming for those sweet enterprise dollars in 2026
description: OpenAI has reportedly appointed Barret Zoph to lead its push into enterprise just a week after Zoph rejoined the company.
author: Rebecca Szkutak

title: Voice AI engine and OpenAI partner LiveKit hits $1B valuation
description: The five-year-old-startup powers OpenAI’s ChatGPT voice mode and raised a $100 million round led by Index Ventures.
author: Marina Temkin

title: Inference startup Inferact lands $150M to commercialize vLLM
description: The seed round values the newly formed startup at $800 million.
author: Marina Temkin

title: Are AI agents ready for the workplace? A new benchmark raises doubts
description: New research looks at how leading AI models hold up doing actual white-collar work tasks, drawn from consulting, investment banking, and law. Most models failed.
author: Russell Brandom

title: Google DeepMind CEO is ‘surprised’ OpenAI is rushing forward with ads in ChatGPT
description: Google DeepMind CEO Demis Hassabis says the tech giant isn't pressuring him to insert ads into the AI chatbot experience.
author: Sarah Perez

title: Humans& thinks coordination is the next frontier for AI, and they’re building a model to prove it
description: Humans&, a new startup founded by alumni of Anthropic, Meta, OpenAI, xAI, and Google DeepMind, is building the next generation of foundation models for collaboration, not chat.
author: Rebecca Bellan

title: Google now offers free SAT practice exams, powered by Gemini
description: Students can prompt Gemini by typing "I want to take a practice SAT test,” and the AI will provide them with a free practice exam. Gemini then analyzes the results, highlighting strengths and identifying areas that need further review. It also offers detailed explanations for any incorrect answers.
author: Lauren Forristal

title: Google’s AI Mode can now tap into your Gmail and Photos to provide tailored responses
description: The company notes that AI Mode doesn’t train directly on your Gmail inbox or Google Photos library. Instead, it trains on specific prompts and the model’s responses.
author: Aisha Malik

title: Google reportedly snags team behind AI voice startup Hume AI
description: Google has hired the CEO and top engineer behind voice AI startup Hume AI, signaling that voice is increasingly becoming the preferred interface over screens.
author: Rebecca Bellan

title: From invisibility cloaks to AI chips: Neurophos raises $110M to build tiny optical processors for inferencing
description: Neurophos is taking a crack at solving the AI industry's power efficiency problem with an optical chip that uses a composite material to do the math required in AI inferencing tasks.
author: Ram Iyer

title: Anthropic has to keep revising its technical interview test as Claude improves
description: The issue of AI cheating is already wreaking havoc at schools and universities around the world, so it's ironic that AI labs are having to deal with it too. But Anthropic is also uniquely well-equipped to deal with the problem.
author: Russell Brandom

title: Spotify brings AI-powered Prompted Playlists to the U.S. and Canada
description: Now available in the US and Canada, Spotify's AI-powered Prompted Playlists let users describe what they want to hear using natural language commands.
author: Sarah Perez

title: Quadric rides the shift from cloud AI to on-device inference — and it’s paying off
description: Quadric aims to help companies and governments build programmable on-device AI chips that can run fast-changing models locally.
author: Jagmeet Singh

title: Former Google trio is building an interactive AI-powered learning app for kids
description: Big tech companies and upcoming startups want to use generative AI to build software and hardware for kids. A lot of those experiences are limited to text or voice, and kids might not find that captivating. Three former Google employees want to get over that hurdle with their generative AI-powered interactive app, Sparkli. Sparkli was […]
author: Ivan Mehta
